transport.title: TRAX Green Line
transport.text: TRAX Green Line serves the airport directly: Airport Station is immediately outside the terminal. According to UTA, the line operates daily from 05:21 to 23:21 and provides access to City Center. At North Temple, you can transfer to FrontRunner towards Ogden or Provo, but FrontRunner does not run on Sundays. UTA information: +1 801 7433882.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the airport. Select SLCAirport.wifi, open your browser, accept the terms and press CONNECT on the connection page.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Bringit Travel offers luggage storage during layovers or longer stays. Bags are handed over and collected at the airport; book the service on Bringit's website.
